tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// rgyud sde'i dkar chag bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma shrī bhaṭ+ṭā rā ka badz+ra dhā rā ya/ rdo rje 'chang chen nyid kyi thugs rje yis// gzhan gyi don du skye bo'i skur bstan nas// skal ba ji bzhin gdul bya'i don mdzad pa// sa skya'i bla chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rje btsun rin po che rgyal mtshan gyi mthas rnam par brgyan pa'i zhal snga nas/ bod du 'gyur ba'i yang dag pa'i rgyun du rin po che bzhi po phal mo che'i mtshan phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa las gnyis su med pa'i rgyud thog mar smos shing*/ bla ma chos kyi rjes bsgyur ba'i rgyud rnams bsnan te bri bar bya ba ni/ 'di lta ste/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud la kye'i rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ thun mong gi bshad pa'i rgyud dpal saṃ pu ṭa thig le'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa/ brtag pa gnyis pa'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi mar grags pa phyag rgya chen po'i thig le/ ye shes thig le de kho na'i sgron ma/ gsang ba'i sgron ma/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ste thig le'i rgyud lnga/ ye shes snying po rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ rnyog pa med pa'i ā ral+li/ rdo rje ā ral+li/ ṛ gi ā ral+li/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ dam pa dang po'i rtsa ba'i rgyud/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud bsdus pa/ dbang gi don ston pa'i rgyud kyi dum bu/ mgon po mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho mchog tu gsang ba las thod pa brtag pa'i rgyud gsum/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyu gsang ba chen po rnams shes rab kyi rgyud la 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud mkha' 'gro ma kun spyod/ a bhi dha na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ he ru ka mngon 'byung*/ phag mo mngon 'byung*/

sdom pa 'byung ba/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor gyi rgyud/ 'bum pa gsum pa las ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i nang nas byung ba'i le'u gcig sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ zla gsang thig le/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ dbang gi don ston/ rgyud kyi dum bu/ man+t+ra aṃ sa/ bshad rgyud chen mo/ ma hā mā yā/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi rnams so// thabs kyi rgyud la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma/ rdo rje phreng ba/ dgongs pa lung ston/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag gzhon nu gdong drug rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rnam par snang mdzad/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rnams so// rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la rtsa ba'i rgyud/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa/ rdo rje rtse mo/ dpal mchog dang po/ khams gsum rnam rgyal/ mgon po kun snang*/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud/ thams cad gsang ba rnams so// bla ma chos kyi rje'i zhal snga nas bsgyur ba ni/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ 'du ba rab gsal/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa'i rgyud/ gsang ba nor bu thig le rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du 'du bar gsal la/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud bya ba'i rgyud kyi khongs su 'du mod kyi/ 'gyur mdzad pa po gcig pa'i phyir/ phyogs gcig tu bris pa'o// spyod pa'i rgyud la/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud/ gshin rje gshed khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud/ pra khog bslang rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa chen po/ bya ba'i rgyud la rigs gsum so so'i rgyud/ rig pa'i lha mo'i rgyud/ thun mong gi rgyud gsum las/ rigs gsum so so'i 'jam dpal gyi rgyud la dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa/

dum bu'i rgyud la 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa/ 'jam dpal gyi dmod btsugs pa/ shes rab blo 'phel/ shes rab bskyed pa/ 'jam dpal gho ṣa ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal la lha mo brgyad kyis bstod pa/ 'jam dpal yig 'bru gcig pa rnams so// spyan ras gzigs kyi rgyud la/ don yod zhags pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa chen po/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong gi rtog pa rgyas pa/ thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs/ za ma tog bkod pa'i rtog pa rgyas pa/ spyan ras gzigs ha la ha la'i rtog pa rgyas pa/ 'phags pa me kha la/ snying rje mi bshol ba'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi yum/ spyan ras gzigs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'khor los sgyur ba'i rtog pa chen po/ ha ya gṛ wa'i gzungs kyi dum bu/ seng ge sgra'i dam bcas pa'i gzungs kyi dum bu rnams so// phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud la/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ kṛ ya rig pa mchog gi rgyud/ dpung pa bzang po/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud snga 'dres gcig rdo rje rnam 'joms/ de'i bshad rgyud/ ri rab khang bu brtsegs pa/ rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar 'bar ba rmongs byed/ rdo rje snying po'i gzungs/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa stobs po che'i gzungs/ lag na rdo rje bcu'i gzungs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dum bu/ 'phags pa rdo rje mchu/ gnam lcags mchu/ lcags kyi mchu/ lcags kyi mchu nag po/ drang srong gi klu la dmod bor ba'i gzungs/ klu'i rgyal po sog ma med pa'i rtog pa rgyas pa rnams so// rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyi gzungs la/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor dri med/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar rgyas 'bring gsum/ sgrol ma las sna tshogs pa'i rgyud/ ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa/ 'od zer can gyi rtsa ba'i sngags/

de'i rtog pa chen po/ 'phags pa rdo rje lcags sgrog skul byed ma'i gzungs/ gza' rnams kyi yum/ gzungs grwa lnga/ 'phags pa be con nag po/ 'phags pa yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ 'phags pa rnam par rgyal ba/ 'phags pa phyir bzlog pa rnam par rgyal ba can ma/ thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin ma/ phyir bzlog pa stobs can ma/ bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyor ma/ 'phags pa dug sel ma/ mdangs phyir 'phrog pa'i gzungs/ rin chen phreng ba'i dum bu/ 'phags pa rgyal ba can/ par+ṇa sha ba ri'i gzungs/ me ltar 'bar ba'i gzungs/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo sgron ma mchog dbyig ldan ma'i gzungs/ yi ge drug pa'i gzungs/ 'gro ldeng ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo/ dpal chen mo'i gzungs/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ rims nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ mig nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ mig nad rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs/ gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen mo/ mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum/ gtsug gi nor bu'i gzungs/ tsan+dan gyi yan lag dri ma med pa/ stong 'khyil ba/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum gyi gzungs/ byang chub snying po rgyan gyi gzungs rnams so// //thun mong gi rgyud la/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po/ gsang ba spyi rgyud/ legs par grub pa/ bsam gtan phyi ma/ gser 'od dam pa/ 'og min gyi tshe dpag med/ bde ba can gyi tshe dpag med/ chos kyi rgya mtsho/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa/ nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang*/ 'jigs pa brgyad las sgrol ba/ gzungs chen po gsang ba'i ring bsrel gyi za ma tog sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs/

mtshan mo bzang po/ 'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la/ ye shes ta la la/ ye shes skar mda'/ me tog brtsegs pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo kun nas 'od/ kun tu bzang po'i gzungs/ gser can gyi gzungs/ 'dus pa chen po'i gzungs/ kun tu rgyu ba dang mthun pa dang mi mthun pa/ sangs rgyas bdun pa/ bu mang po rton pa/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas kyi yan lag dang ldan pa/ sor mo can/ lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa/ bde ba bsgrags pa/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs/ stong 'gyur/ kaṃ ka ni'i gzungs/ chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i gzungs/ bdud rtsi sman gyi gzungs/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa'i gzungs/ sprin chen po las char dbab pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i le'u/ klu thams cad kyi snying po/ 'dus pa chen po rin chen tog 'dus pa chen po nyi ma'i snying po/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs sngags dang bcas pa rnams so// //snga 'gyur gyi rgyud la/ rdo rje phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu/ gsang ba snying po/ sgyu 'phrul bla ma/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul/ thabs kyi zhags pa/ sgyu 'phrul brgyad cu pa rnams so// //'jig rten pa'i rgyud la/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i gzungs/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs/ gar mkhan mchog gi rtog pa chen po rnams so// //de ltar shin tu zab pa'i don ston pa// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde dam pa rnams// dri med rin chen gser gyi rang bzhin gyis// dri bar 'dod pa'i lhag bsam dang ldan pa// 'bri klung dam pa chos phyug ldan stod du// smon lam dag pas nye bar skyes gyur pa// ston seng zhes byas rje btsun rin chen la// dri med rgyud kyi mtshan phreng zhus mod kyang*// sbyor ba rtsom bzhin rkyen gyis ma grub pa// de yi dbon po blo gros dang ldan pa// dbang phyug rgyal po zhes byas rab 'bad nas// dpal ldan chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i// zhabs pad dri med yun ring brten byas nas// gsung rab bdud rtsis blo gros tshim par byas// de yi tsha bo bkra shis tshul khrims dpal// bzang po zhes bya ming gzhan dbon nag tu// grags pa des kyang dpal ldan sa skya pa// 'phags pa zhes byar yongs su grags gyur pa'i// zhabs pad btud nas chos kyi bdud rtsi nos// de yi bla ma'i bka' drin dran phyir dang*// rgyal po yab sras sku tshe ring phyir dang*// khu mes dag gi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*// rgyal khams chos bzhin bde legs bya phyir dang*// rang gi bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir// hor gyi rgyal rabs lnga pa'i rgyal po mchog

/ga gan rgyal po zhes bya'i sku ring la// chu mo bya lo dbyar zla dus kyi tshe// bai ḍūr+ya yi zhing khams dag pa la// gser bzang 'bar bas tshul bzhin bzhengs pa dang*// bklags dang mchod la sogs pa'i dge ba yis// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa// rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang thob par shog /tshe rabs kun tu gsung rab 'di dag dang*// gzhan yang chos tshul rgya mtsho thams cad la// nye bar zhugs shing rtogs pa mchog gyur te// gzhan dag la yang rgya cher ston par shog /gnas skabs chos kyi rgyal po yon mchod dang*// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa kun// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs pa dang*// blo kun chos dang mthun zhing bde legs shog /'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan bde rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
